parameters.query: SELECT ec.id, ec.campaign_name, ec.campaign_type, ec.status, ec.client_id, ec.stats, ec.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.activity_data->>'campaign_id' = ec.id::text AND la.activity_type LIKE '%email_sent%') as total_sent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.activity_data->>'campaign_id' = ec.id::text AND la.activity_type = 'email_opened') as total_opened, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.activity_data->>'campaign_id' = ec.id::text AND la.activity_type = 'email_clicked') as total_clicked, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT la.contact_id) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.activity_data->>'campaign_id' = ec.id::text AND la.activity_type = 'converted') as total_conversions, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.deal_value), 0) FROM deals d JOIN lead_activities la ON la.contact_id = d.contact_id WHERE la.activity_data->>'campaign_id' = ec.id::text AND d.stage = 'closed_won') as revenue_attributed FROM email_campaigns ec WHERE ec.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY ec.created_at DESC
